/**
 * API {{controllerName}} controller spec — generated by the Wheels CLI.
 *
 * This is code you own — extend it as your endpoints grow. Run with
 * `wheels test` after `wheels migrate latest`.
 *
 * Test data: beforeEach persists a record with model().create(properties=...).
 * Assertions follow Rails `--api` scaffold spirit (201 create, 204 delete,
 * count deltas) using processRequest + WheelsTest.
 */
component extends="wheels.WheelsTest" {

	function run() {

		describe("API {{controllerName}} Controller", () => {

			beforeEach(() => {
				variables.{{modelNameLower}} = model("{{modelName}}").create(properties = {{validAttributes}});
			});

			it("GET /api/{{pluralLower}} returns JSON list", () => {
				result = processRequest(params={route: "{{collectionRoute}}", format: "json"}, method="get", returnAs="struct");
				expect(result).toHaveKey("status");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("GET /api/{{pluralLower}}/:key returns JSON record", () => {
				result = processRequest(params={route: "{{memberRoute}}", key: variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id, format: "json"}, method="get", returnAs="struct");
				expect(result).toHaveKey("status");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("POST /api/{{pluralLower}} creates record", () => {
				var beforeCount = model("{{modelName}}").count();
				result = processRequest(params={route: "{{collectionRoute}}", format: "json", {{modelNameLower}}: {{validAttributes}}}, method="post", returnAs="struct");
				expect(result).toHaveKey("status");
				expect(result.status).toBe(201);
				expect(model("{{modelName}}").count()).toBe(beforeCount + 1);
			});

			it("PUT /api/{{pluralLower}}/:key updates record", () => {
				result = processRequest(params={route: "{{memberRoute}}", key: variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id, format: "json", {{modelNameLower}}: {{validAttributes}}}, method="put", returnAs="struct");
				expect(result).toHaveKey("status");
				expect(result.status).toBe(200);
			});

			it("DELETE /api/{{pluralLower}}/:key deletes record", () => {
				var beforeCount = model("{{modelName}}").count();
				result = processRequest(params={route: "{{memberRoute}}", key: variables.{{modelNameLower}}.id, format: "json"}, method="delete", returnAs="struct");
				expect(result).toHaveKey("status");
				expect(result.status).toBe(204);
				expect(model("{{modelName}}").count()).toBe(beforeCount - 1);
			});

		});

	}

}
